experience.description: Over the past two years, I have gained extensive experience as a full-stack developer, working on dynamic and scalable web applications. At Fujn, I developed robust Node.js backend services, ensuring seamless integration for both web and mobile platforms. I independently built an Instagram clone using Next.js and MongoDB, implementing features like authentication, image uploads, posts, likes, and comments to provide a smooth user experience. Additionally, I contributed to SportConn as a full-stack developer, utilizing Next.js for the frontend and Node.js for the backend to deliver high-performance and user-friendly solutions.
Led full-stack development of web and mobile apps (React Native, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL), building scalable real-time backends and improving performance with a 30% faster API and enhanced UX.
